narr: Tropical Storm Francine made landfall in southern Louisiana on the evening of September 11th, 2024. The weakening storm produced strong wind damage as it moved across central Mississippi the morning of September 12th, 2024.
ev: Heavy rain associated with Tropical Storm Francine flooded a few roads in Simpson County.
The intersection of Gulde Road and Highway 80 was closed due to flash flooding.
The intersection at Germania Road and Highway 3 was closed due to flooding.
Water pooled over the road and approached houses near Hanging Moss Road.
